stories.title: Silent Patches Don’t Stop Attackers—They Blind Defenders
stories.description: Silent patches can become exploit intelligence for attackers while leaving defenders without the context needed to prioritize risk.

stories.title: EvilTokens Doesn’t Just Steal Microsoft Sessions—Its AI Tells Attackers Who to Scam Next
stories.description: EvilTokens steals Microsoft 365 sessions via device-code phishing, then analyzes mailboxes to help criminals target fraud.

stories.title: CISA Warns of Oracle HTTP and WebLogic Server Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
stories.description: CISA added CVE-2026-21962, an improper access control flaw in Oracle HTTP Server and WebLogic Proxy Plug-in, to its KEV Catalog after confirming active exploitation.

stories.title: Hackers Exploit Critical miniOrange SAML SSO Flaws to Hijack WordPress Admin Accounts
stories.description: Two critical miniOrange SAML 2.0 SSO flaws let unauthenticated attackers take over WordPress accounts, including admins.

stories.title: Critical Red Hat Keycloak Flaw Lets Unauthenticated Attackers Take Over Any User Account
stories.description: Red Hat disclosed a vulnerability in Red Hat Build of Keycloak that allow unauthenticated remote attackers to take over arbitrary user accounts.

stories.title: Attackers Target miniOrange SAML Flaws That Can Grant WordPress Admin Access
stories.description: Attackers are scanning for two miniOrange SAML flaws, including CVE-2026-15981, that can bypass login and grant WordPress admin access.

stories.title: Taiwan Charges 9 Over Illegal AI Server Exports to China, Including Nvidia and Super Micro Staff
stories.description: AI infrastructure, including advanced semiconductors mostly made in Taiwan, has become a key point of competition between the U.S. and China.

stories.title: CISA Warns of Exploited Oracle WebLogic Vulnerability
stories.description: The vulnerability is tracked as CVE-2026-21962 and it has been widely exploited by threat actors against WebLogic servers.

stories.title: Actively Exploited Oracle WebLogic Flaw Lets Unauthenticated Attackers Access Critical Data
stories.description: CISA adds actively exploited CVE-2026-21962 to KEV; the Oracle flaw can expose or alter critical data via unauthenticated HTTP access.

stories.title: Weedhack Malware Spreads via Fake Minecraft Clients and SEO Poisoning
stories.description: Weedhack spreads through fake Minecraft client sites and SEO poisoning, with McAfee blocking more than 6,300 attempts to reach malicious URLs.

stories.title: ReliaQuest Confirms ShinyHunters Hack, but Says Impact Was Limited
stories.description: A ReliaQuest employee fell victim to a phishing attack and the hackers gained access to a dashboard.
